howto.name: Upload an MKV file
howto.text: Drop an .mkv file up to 500 MB.

howto.name: PrivaTools re-encodes via FFmpeg
howto.text: The video is re-encoded as VP9, which browsers play natively and MKV never could.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. The result is VP9 WebM — open, royalty-free and suited to HTML5 video where MKV has no browser support at all.

faq.a: Often partially — WebM requires VP8/VP9 video and Vorbis/Opus audio, so any stream not already in those codecs is re-encoded. Both are Matroska-based, so the container step itself is straightforward.
To embed open-format video on the web without proprietary codecs.
